title: This GitHub Tool Stops Your AI Agent From Bugging You
description:
Your AI agent keeps pinging you for every tiny thing and it drives you nuts 😅

Someone just put out Agent Chief on GitHub, its basically a local filter that sits between you and your agents and decide if you're actually worth interrupting. Every alert goes through three layers before it reaches you. Hard rules first. Then a classifier. Then a LLM judge that makes the final call, interrupt or stay quiet.

It hit 500 stars in the first week which kinda tells you how many people been dealing with this exact problem 🔥 all runs locally too, nothing leaves your machine. Pretty neat little idea honestly ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
